name: Zoledronic acid
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 4 mg IV over at least 15 minutes; may repeat after at least 7 days
4 mg IV over at least 15 minutes every 3 to 4 weeks, with calcium 500 mg and vitamin D 400 units daily
5 mg IV once a year (CrCl ≥35; contraindicated <35)

serious: Kidney failure (even at 4 mg over 15 minutes)

contraindications: Reclast 5 mg: CrCl <35 mL/min or acute renal impairment; hypocalcemia

pk.half_life: Triphasic: 0.24 and 1.87 hours early; terminal about 146 hours
pk.half_life_eskd: AUC doubled at CrCl 10 mL/min (model; label)
pk.excretion_renal_pct: About 39% ± 16% of dose in urine within 24 hours; rest bound to bone
